name: Smartsheet
description: Smartsheet is an intelligent work management platform that combines a spreadsheet-style grid interface with project tracking, automation, and enterprise reporting.
best_for: Project and portfolio managers, enterprise PMOs, and IT teams who want spreadsheet-familiar tools with enterprise-grade governance.
features: Gantt charts for timeline and dependency tracking
Workflow automation to reduce manual work
Forms and centralized intake and approval workflows
Integrations with Microsoft, Salesforce, Slack, and Jira

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Restricted to 1-10 members. Only available to new customers, per the vendor's own pricing page.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Requires 3+ members. Marked as the most popular tier.

alternatives.name: Wrike
alternatives.description: An AI-powered enterprise work management platform with Gantt charts, dashboards, and resource management.
alternatives.best_for: Cross-functional teams needing enterprise-grade project visibility

alternatives.name: Airtable
alternatives.description: A spreadsheet-database hybrid for building custom apps and tracking work.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want database flexibility with a spreadsheet interface

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A work management platform for tracking tasks, projects, and cross-team workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need structured task tracking and workflow automation

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, and organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool
